speaker: Doctor
text: The blood work shows significant anemia, thrombocytopenia, and a markedly elevated white blood cell count, which strongly supports a diagnosis of leukemia. I need to see the morphology of the cells to confirm the type. REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Aspirate_and_Biopsy

text: RESULTS: Findings: Predominantly immature cells that are positive for CD10, CD19, and TdT.

The bone marrow biopsy confirms the presence of lymphoblasts expressing CD10, CD19, and TdT, which is diagnostic for B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia. I have enough information to make a definitive diagnosis.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL)
